programme.title: En Rasavin Manasile
programme.desc: Solaiamma hastily agrees to marry Mayandi as he is an alcoholic, but love blooms between the couple when Mayandi changes himself. However, he is shattered when she dies after giving birth to a baby.
programme.sub-title: Solaiamma hastily agrees to marry Mayandi as he is an alcoholic, but love blooms between the couple when Mayandi changes himself. However, he is shattered when she dies after giving birth to a baby.

programme.title: Poster Boyz
programme.sub-title: Inspired by a true event, three men find themselves in a chaotic predicament when their photos grace a vasectomy advertisement. Subjected to ridicule by friends and family, they unite to rebel againstg the system. The comedy movie stars Shreyas Talpade, Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol.

programme.title: Mubarakan
programme.sub-title: Orphaned twins who are raised separately turn to their quirky unmarried uncle for romantic advice, unaware of the chaos and confusion in store for them. 'Mubarakan' stars Anil Kapoor, Arjun Kapoor, Ileana D'Cruz, Athiya Shetty, Neha Sharma, Ratna Pathak Shah, Karan Kundra, Rahul Dev, Pavan Malhotra and Sanjay Kapoor.

programme.title: Policewala
programme.sub-title: A young man, whose father fell victim to a gangster's violence, grows up to enlist in the police. During his pursuit of a notorious gang, he unintentionally uncovers the identity of his father's killer. 'Policewala' stars Chunky Pandey, Sonam, Vinod Mehra, Amjad Khan and Shakti Kapoor.

programme.title: Firangi
programme.desc: Set in the 1920s, the undisputed King of Comedy Kapil Sharma plays a young man with the unique ability to cure backaches with a kick. However, the family of the girl he wants to marry rejects his proposal as he serves the very people against whom they have been fighting for independence. 'Firangi' also stars Ishita Dutta and Monica Gill.
programme.sub-title: Unable to live up to his father's expectations, Heera battles against adversity to uphold his family's honor and pride. 'Sooryavansham' stars Amitabh Bachchan in a double role, along with Soundarya, Jayasudha, Rachna Banerjee, Kader Khan, Anupam Kher, Mukesh Rishi and Aanand Vardhan.

programme.title: Darr@ The Mall
programme.sub-title: A newly built mall becomes shrouded in mystery as several workers die mysteriously during construction. A security guard unravels the haunting secret behind the mall's dark past. The horror movie stars Jimmy Sheirgill, Nushratt Bharucha, Arif Zakaria and Asif Basra.

programme.title: No Parking
programme.sub-title: Arun is an architect who has a loving mother, and a beautiful girlfriend. Things go haywire when he parks his bike in a "No Parking" zone. This takes him on a roller coaster ride full of lies and deceit.

programme.title: Charms Bond
programme.sub-title: Hilarity ensues when a young man, his cousin and a friend hatch a plan to steal money from his miserly step-mother. 'Charms Bond' stars Priya Anand, Yogi Babu and Mirchi Shiva.

programme.title: Lucifer
programme.sub-title: After the death of the ruling party's supreme leader in God's own country, a power vaccuum gives rise to unprecedent forces in the chaos for succession, impacting both the party and state. The 2019 Malayalam blockbuster Lucifer stars Mohanlal, Vivek Oberois and Manju Warrier.

programme.title: Baadshah Pehlwaan
programme.sub-title: Krishna is an orphan who is being brought up by a gym owner whose name is Sarkar. Krishna beats the odds to become a Baadshah Pehlwaan, but when he falls in love, he gets into a dispute with himself.

programme.title: Azhar
programme.desc: Inspired by the life of Indian cricketer and former captain of the Indian national team, Mohammad Azharuddin. A talented young cricketer rises to prominence but finds his career threatened by accusations of match-fixing. 'Azhar' stars Emraan Hashmi, Lara Dutta and Nargis Fakhri.
programme.sub-title: A beautiful woman and an auto driver fake a romantic relationship to deter suitors, but their plan backfires as they unexpectedly develop real feelings for each other. The romantic-drama movie stars Nagarjuna, Deepti Bhatnagar, Simran and Dara Singh.
